crossRefs.note: He had a helmet of bronze on his head, and he wore a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels…
crossRefs.keyword: armed David with his armour. Heb. clothed David with hisclothes

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul dressed David with his clothing. He put a helmet of bronze on his head, and he clad him with a coat of mail.
translations.bsb: Then Saul clothed David in his own tunic, put a bronze helmet on his head, and dressed him in armor.
translations.kjv: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.
translations.asv: And Saul clad David with his apparel, and he put a helmet of brass upon his head, and he clad him with a coat of mail.
